chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Safwan al-Jamal, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever recites 'Wailun lil-mutaffifeen' (Doom to the defrauding ones) in the obligatory prayer, Allah grants him safety on the Day of Judgment from the Fire, neither would the Fire see him nor will he see the Fire, and he will not pass over the bridge of Hell, nor will he be called to account on the Day of Judgment.

key_terms.وَيْلٌ لِلْمُطَفِّفِينَ: Doom to the defrauding ones (Opening phrase of Surah Al-Mutaffifeen)
key_terms.يُحَاسَب: He will be called to account / reckoned

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Al-Mutaffifeen in obligatory prayers?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq emphasizes the transformative power of specific Quranic recitation, linking the concept of 'Mutaffifeen' (those who give less in measure) to spiritual security. The promise of exemption from the Sirat bridge and the Day of Reckoning (Hisab) underscores a high degree of divine mercy for the faithful who internalize this warning against dishonesty during their obligatory prayers.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Safwan al-Jamal from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:

Whoever recites Surah Mutaffifeen in his obligatory prayers, Allah would keep him safe from the fire of Hell on the Day of Judgment, neither would the fire of Hell see him nor will he see the fire of Hell, and the reciter of Surah Mutaffifeen would not have to pass over the bridge of Hell, not would face any questioning on the Day of Judgment.
